## 👋 About Me

<table>
<tr>
<td width="58%" valign="top">

I'm **Habibi Ahmad Aziz**, a frontend-leaning fullstack developer from **Karawang, Indonesia** 🇮🇩. I ship web products end to end — UI systems and the APIs behind them — with a bias for **performance you can measure, not just claim**.

At **PT Webekspres Teknologi Indonesia** I work as a **Web Developer** and also serve as an **AWS Cloud Computing Trainer**, building production digital solutions for businesses, government agencies, and schools — while pushing further into cloud architecture and AI-integrated systems on the side.

**Recognition**
- 🏆 **Intel® AI Global Impact Festival 2025** — Indonesia Country Award, for *Agrify / Smartfarm AI*
- 🏆 **Top 15 Best Capstone Team** — Coding Camp powered by DBS Foundation
- 🎓 **Coding Camp Graduate with Distinction** — Front-End & Back-End Developer Track

**How I ship:** scope the real job → thin vertical slice end to end → harden what users can break → measure, then decorate.
